chapter: Cab Calloway, Lunceford, Hampton and Armstrong, 1941-45
title: Building Armstrong's new band and becoming musical director
summary: Joe Glaser wanted a younger band for Louis Armstrong, whose old band was losing men, and put McRae in charge.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: And then when I came back, Glaser had still wanted me to go out -- I was (inaudible). Called me up one day -- he wanted me -- I was still writing. I say I come back to writing and stuff, but then I picked -- Sid Wyche and I started doing some writing together. Still writing these rock and roll things, you know, rhythm and blues. So, now Hamp want me -- Joe Glaser wanted me -- asked me could I build Louie a band. And he only give me -- Sent From the time -- he (inaudible) Louie was off New York two weeks. I went down and heard -- He had this band that Joe Thomas, the other tenor player -- with Louie. And the band wasn't a bad band. But Joe just figured that he was gonna try and get him a younger band, because for the simple
